root_causes.description: The checkout container was killed ('Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted'), and the replacement pod cannot start because its sandbox image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails to pull with DeadlineExceeded, leaving the pod in ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff. As a result checkout serves no traffic (server request rate collapses to ~0) and its callers (frontend, accounting, fraud-detection) are impacted.

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted (count=1)
evidence.observed_value: count=1 kill event on checkout pod during window
evidence.expected_baseline: no container kill events during steady state

evidence.query_or_id: Failed: Failed to pull image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = failed to pull a
evidence.observed_value: ErrImagePull count=3, ImagePullBackOff count=4, BackOff count=4
evidence.expected_baseline: sandbox image pulls succeed; pod becomes Ready
steady-state checkout server request rate well above 0.1 req/s

evidence.observed_value: error_rate=0.000 (no checkout server spans emitted at all)
evidence.expected_baseline: nonzero server span throughput; absence of spans indicates pod is down

evidence.observed_value: error_rate mean=0.063, p95=0.145, max=0.171 on upstream caller frontend

root_causes.description: Frontend, a direct caller of checkout, shows an elevated server error rate during the window; this is a downstream-propagation symptom of the checkout outage rather than an independent fault, and no frontend error traces were recorded.

evidence.expected_baseline: error traces present when frontend is the failing origin

root_causes.description: Alternative: a resource-pressure driven termination (e.g. CPU stress/OOM) could have triggered the restart, but measured checkout CPU is negligible and no restart counters fired, so this is not supported by the evidence.

remediation_steps: Confirm checkout pod state: kubectl get pods -n otel-demo -l app=checkout and check for ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull and restart counts.

Roll back the checkout Deployment to the previous working container definition — the kill event 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' shows a recent spec change triggered the outage.

Fix the sandbox/pause image pull path: the pull of gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails with DeadlineExceeded — verify registry connectivity/DNS, use an accessible mirror or pre-pulled image, or set imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent.
Once the pod becomes Ready, verify recovery by confirming checkout server request rate returns to baseline and frontend error rate drops below 0.01.
